title: tommos
description: Tommos is a high-performance finite-element micromagnetic simulation package combining JAX and C++ for CPU- and GPU-based computations. It supports sparse-matrix formulations of micromagnetic interactions, numerical energy minimization, and the simulation of magnetic hysteresis.
